role: bounded prospective development diagnosis, not public qualification

design.within_match_covariance: Gaussian serial AR(1), rho=0.65, scaled to tau_g=0.26+0.08*normalized_midrank(F_g)
design.target: Original separately weighted FE components, fixed 1000 target-mass multiplier at match (0,0)
design.larger_samples: Not part of this bounded simulation; their exact moment diagnosis remains separate immutable evidence

arm_semantics.first_word: Control offset: known subtracts C*gamma and supplies no controls; estimated supplies original y and C to the unchanged production fixed-offset joint FE/control fit
arm_semantics.second_word: Variance: known supplies original scalar aggregate tau to the existing grouped oracle attachment; fitted uses the unchanged grouped structured_common model
arm_semantics.known_variance_caveat: Known tau is NOT the full transformed covariance after estimating controls; this deliberate omission isolates the fixed-offset approximation
arm_semantics.point_identity: Known and fitted variance arms for the same offset must have exactly identical production point estimates and match the unattached point calculation

rng.algorithm: NumPy PCG64 standard_normal for physical-row Gaussian innovations; production Counter-V1 for estimator and covariance probes
rng.semantic_key: SplitMix64(master XOR SplitMix64(replication)); separate SplitMix64 domains 1 for outcome and 2 for production seed
rng.pairing: All four arms use exactly the same physical-row errors and production seed; fold seed is fixed across outcomes and fitted arms
rng.order_invariance: One unique input and result per semantic replication, independent of task order, shard boundaries, or local worker count

numerics.critical_reference: unchanged independent deterministic q1 quadrature for diagnostic intervals, retaining the production critical value

preflight.method: Exact independent Gaussian moment and generalized-spectrum oracle before outcome draws

known_offset_calibration_checks.estimated_offset_arms: descriptive limitations, never relabeled as known-offset calibration claims
known_offset_calibration_checks.covariance_target: multi-mode diagnostic, excluded prospectively from q1 calibration claims

reporting: Every attempted arm-target including shared and target-local failures; no four-arm complete-case filtering
Bias, empirical SD, mean reported SE, q1 coverage among all attempts and among available intervals, availability, width, lower/upper misses, and MCSE
Paired all-attempt coverage differences and MCSE for all four factorial edges and the interaction; jointly available comparisons separately labeled
Average leading/remainder covariance terms and model variance relative to the independent exact moment expectations
Retain exact and randomized spectral diagnostics separately; never gate on an adverse average 128-probe remainder ratio
A q0 interval computed from the existing full covariance is diagnostic only and never a fallback for q1
gates_before_diagnostic: Focused Rust and Python tests, strict Rust formatting/Clippy, complete tiny generator-to-validator-to-receipt run
Test missing, duplicate, malformed, nonfinite, mixed-source, wrong-seed, mismatched-truth, partial, and scientifically failing input
Verify pairing, same-offset point identity, fixed and design-equivalent folds, full-source and binary binding, input identities, and new-only atomic files
Independent physical-row dense fit and exact moment comparisons on tiny real runs; no code or criterion tuning after diagnostic outcomes
boundaries: No second-stage nuisance correction, interval inflation, ridge rescue, automatic q/model choice, or public route
No change to frozen earlier campaigns, accepted evidence, estimands, controls, or target weights
Full match q0 and fresh observation q1 confirmation remain separate follow-up steps before project integration
